core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mursalin is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Messengers”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mursalin corresponds to the Arabic form مُرْسَلِين (Arabic root ر س ل (r-s-l); مُرْسَلِين (Mursalīn)). Its core sense is mursalin; messengers (plural). Mursalin is Arabic مُرْسَلِين (Mursalīn) 'messengers', the plural of مُرْسَل (mursal), from the root ر س ل (r-s-l). The source gloss 'The one who brings the message' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as mursaleen.
